summary: Iteration-3 features tested end-to-end. Backend: 27 new tests (verification detail with RBAC docs, global search grouped results, write-action RBAC on liveness/identity) + 64 regression tests (iter1+iter2) = 91/91 PASSED. Frontend: verification detail navigation (liveness+identity), decision buttons (approve/reject with reason), back-to-queue, command palette (Ctrl+K + topbar button, RPT/TKT search, 23 nav items, click-to-navigate), column visibility toggle on payments, CSV & Excel export downloads, Analyst restricted docs (Restricted panels + no decision buttons on both liveness & identity), plus regression on 10 pages — all working.

issues: Radix a11y console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' — the cmdk DialogContent lacks a DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper). Cosmetic/a11y only; palette works.

action_items: (a11y, low priority) Add a VisuallyHidden <DialogTitle> inside CommandPalette's CommandDialog to silence the Radix Dialog a11y warning on Ctrl+K open.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py verification_detail() correctly gates document access via can_view_documents: True for Owner/Super Admin OR when can_write(role, kind); Read-only Analyst and roles without the module get False. Analyst returns 200 on GET (page loads) but 403 on POST action — correct behavior for restricted read.
server.py /search: q<2 returns empty results; auth required (401 verified); User/Report/Ticket groups each return type/id/title/subtitle/route — clean.
VerificationDetail.jsx correctly hides decision buttons behind canWrite = can(kind), and DocPanel renders 'Restricted' + Lock icon when can_view_documents=false plus an amber warning banner.

DataTable.jsx column toggle stores hidden columns in local component state — resets on unmount/navigation (as expected for now). Export uses visibleColumns so hidden columns are excluded from CSV/Excel — good.
format.js exportExcel writes an HTML table with .xls extension and application/vnd.ms-excel MIME — opens in Excel but is technically HTML; acceptable for demo/no-lib approach.

CommandPalette.jsx does not clear q on close (only on go); minor UX nit — reopening the palette keeps the previous query and cmdk client-side filters nav items to only matching ones (verified 23 items when q is empty, only 2 when q='RPT').
Backend server.py is ~700 lines; approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting resource CRUD, verification, search, and settings/admins into separate routers in a future iteration.
No JS errors observed on any tested flow beyond the a11y warning.
